note: Deterministic SEDENS Standard session builder. No language model, no randomness: the same inputs and library always give the same plan. Priority (brief section 21): readiness, then the customer's goal, duration, experience, room equipment, recent sessions, scan observations, variety. Durations, rests and transition times are design defaults inside the ranges in docs/SEDENS_FEEDBACK_EVIDENCE.md, to be recalibrated from pilot timings. Explained in docs/RECOMMENDATION_RULES.md.

description.en: Gentle movement for the spine, hips and shoulders.
Foundational mat Pilates at a comfortable pace.
description.ko: 편안한 속도로 하는 기초 매트 필라테스예요.

description.en: Controlled exercises for the trunk and hips.
A balanced mix of mobility and mat Pilates.
Easy and relaxed. Your breathing stays calm and chatting is easy.
description.ko: 편안한 강도예요. 호흡이 차분하고 대화가 편해요.

description.en: Steady work. You breathe faster but can still speak in full sentences.
description.ko: 꾸준히 힘을 쓰는 강도예요. 숨이 빨라지지만 문장으로 말할 수 있어요.

intensity_footer.en: You can always slow down or choose an easier option during the session.
intensity_footer.ko: 운동 중에도 언제든 천천히 하거나 쉬운 동작을 고를 수 있어요.

timing.basis: Tempo 3-8 s per slow repetition (ACSM 2009, Schoenfeld 2015, ACSM 2026); rest under 90 s between light sets (ACSM 2009, ACSM 2026); transitions and the first demonstration are design assumptions with no published source, logged for recalibration.

rules.applies: A plan is built only after this visit's readiness check ended ready. Any other outcome ends the room journey before a plan exists.

The customer's goal decides which exercise categories may fill the warm-up, main block and cool-down, in order of preference (see goals); a later category is used only when the earlier ones cannot fill the time. Warm-up and cool-down prefer exercises that do not belong in the main block, so the main block keeps its exercises.
Light keeps to exercises marked light effort with 45 s rests between sets; Moderate allows light and moderate exercises with 35 s rests. Vigorous is not offered in an unsupervised room in v1.

Every step's time is calculated (demonstration, sets x reps x seconds per rep or hold, side switches, rests, transitions). The plan must land inside the duration's range or the customer is told it cannot be filled.

When the audited library cannot fill the chosen duration (for example 60 minutes for a first session, where only foundation exercises and at most 2 sets are used), the customer is offered the shorter plan with its real length and told why. Plans under 20 minutes are not offered.

Fewer than three completed room sessions: foundation-level exercises only, at most 2 sets each. After that: intermediate exercises may be included and at most 3 sets. Sets are added only to fill the main block's time.
Only exercises that need nothing beyond the room's equipment (a mat).

Demonstration facilities may use every SEDENS Standard entry (each is labelled with its review status). Real facilities use only entries reviewed by SEDENS or an expert; until such entries exist, the personalized session explains that it is not available yet.

If the customer reported pain or unusual discomfort after their last room session (within 30 days), today's plan uses light-effort exercises only, no harder options are offered, and the customer is told why. Nothing about the discomfort is interpreted.

customer_explanation.en: Last time you noted discomfort, so today stays light and won't get harder.
customer_explanation.ko: 지난번에 불편감이 있다고 알려 주셔서, 오늘은 가볍게 하고 더 어렵게 하지 않아요.

rules.applies: If the last room session's effort rating was at least 2 above the band of the intensity chosen for it (within 14 days), light-effort exercises are preferred today.

customer_explanation.en: Your last session felt harder than planned, so today starts with lighter exercises.
customer_explanation.ko: 지난 운동이 계획보다 힘들게 느껴져서, 오늘은 가벼운 동작부터 해요.

rules.applies: When the customer has an earlier room session, the reasons say how long ago it was. It changes nothing in the plan.

rules.observation_required: shoulder_line shown (feedback rules sedens-feedback-1.0.0: both front and back views clear, same side, at least the provisional threshold)
excluded_situations: no shoulder-mobility exercise fits the warm-up
rules.applies: Adds at most one gentle shoulder-mobility exercise to the warm-up, as variety only. It never replaces the customer's goal, never changes a creator's course, and makes no claim that the exercise changes the shoulder line.
rules.evidence_note: Posture changes from exercise in adults rest on very low to low certainty evidence (ROQUE-2024); there is no basis to say this exercise changes the observation. The rule is a transparent variety choice, ranked last in priority.

customer_explanation.en: Today's scan: a shoulder-line difference was visible, so one gentle shoulder-mobility exercise is included for variety. It isn't meant to change your shoulder line.
customer_explanation.ko: 오늘 스캔: 어깨선 차이가 보여서 부드러운 어깨 가동 운동을 하나 넣었어요. 어깨선을 바꾸기 위한 것은 아니에요.

rules.applies: Exercises from the customer's previous SEDENS Standard session move behind unused ones of the same preference, so a returning customer sees some variety when the library allows it.

cannot_fill.en: The SEDENS library can't put together a {minutes}-minute session for this goal and effort yet. Try another goal or effort.
cannot_fill.ko: SEDENS 라이브러리로는 아직 이 목표와 강도로 {minutes}분 세션을 구성할 수 없어요. 다른 목표나 강도를 선택해 주세요.

no_reviewed_content.en: Personalized sessions will be available here once SEDENS has reviewed its exercise library.
no_reviewed_content.ko: SEDENS가 운동 라이브러리 검토를 마치면 이곳에서도 맞춤 세션을 이용할 수 있어요.

shorter_plan.en: The SEDENS library can't fill {minutes} minutes for you yet, so this plan is about {available} minutes. You can start it, or choose a shorter time.
shorter_plan.ko: SEDENS 라이브러리로는 아직 {minutes}분을 채울 수 없어, 이 계획은 약 {available}분이에요. 이대로 시작하거나 더 짧은 시간을 선택할 수 있어요.
